newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PT&T 'B' up 8.75 pct at 1.74 pesos.
newsitem.headline: PT&T 'B' up 8.75 pct at 1.74 pesos.

text.p: Philippine Telegraph & Telephone Corp A and B shares surged in late trade as punters picked up the stocks on expected better earnings, traders said.
The B shares went up by 14 centavos, or 8.75 percent, to 1.74 pesos, while the A shares rose 16 centavos, or 10 percent, to 1.76 pesos on moderate volume.
"The company is expected to post better earnings this year as it shifts focus towards the business of international calls," one analyst said.
The company is set to release interim figures for full year ended September in the coming weeks.
